Opening statement: I know this is difficult news, but leadership has decided to close the Northbridge site at the end of next quarter — this decision is final, and from here we will move swiftly to implement the plan while providing reassignment opportunities, separation packages, and practical support to affected employees.  
Q: Can the decision be reversed? A: No — the closure is final; we will not reopen the evaluation and will focus on execution and employee support; Q: Why the tight timeline? A: A short timeline reduces prolonged uncertainty, accelerates access to open roles and support, and preserves regional performance.  
Q: What does this mean for my job? A: HR and your manager will contact impacted employees with individual outcomes — some will be offered reassignment where roles match, others will receive our standard separation package; Q: How are reassignment decisions made? A: By role fit, skills, business need, and timing, applied consistently and communicated promptly.  
Q: What support and next steps can people expect? A: We will provide separation pay, outplacement and counseling, and internal placement assistance; we will hold today’s all‑hands, run a short information period over the coming weeks, begin individual outreach immediately, and complete the transition by the end of next quarter.
